free_tier.stated: No free allowance is offered. Standard USD 6.00/TB/month with free egress up to 3x storage, then USD 1.00 per TB; Unmetered USD 8.00/TB/month with no egress fees.
free_tier.notes: the beta that carried the free allowance ended in January 2025; no free plan is listed now

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: the vendor page states no per-object cap
per_object_cap.notes: the earlier value was the beta's free storage allowance, not a per-object cap

egress.terms: Standard: egress free up to 3x the storage quota, then USD 1.00 per TB. Unmetered: no egress fees. Ingress is free on both plans.
egress.price_per_tb: USD 1.00/TB above 3x storage on Standard; none on Unmetered

tooling: S3-compatible API with an access key per app, created and rotated in the web console; rclone, backup tools and any AWS SDK; a browser file manager with expiring share links. A custom-domain endpoint is listed as coming soon.
chaining: No free allowance exists to multiply across accounts; every TB is billed. Objects are served through pre-signed URLs, public links or static website hosting, and the vendor page names CDN delivery.
limits_note: Capacity is bought per TB and is individually expandable; no API request fees; Standard bills egress above 3x storage at USD 1.00 per TB. The vendor page publishes no per-object, request-rate or bucket cap.

identity_cost.detail: the order signup form has fields for name, postal address, country, phone, email and a password; which fields are required, and the payment methods for the paid plans, are unverified: behind a sign-up

reliability_note: The beta that carried the free allowance ended in January 2025; beta buckets were invoiced for disk usage from their next renewal date. The provider runs colocated hardware and rented dedicated servers.
confidence_note: the vendor page, its order cart and the signup form were read on 2026-10-30: two plans priced per TB and no free plan
